sources.title: Annex E - Governance, Verification & Acceptance Framework (v0.2).pdf
sources.summary: Standard Operating Procedures for joint deliverable sign-offs, milestone verification gates, and Cth acceptance criteria.

sources.summary: SAML 2.0 / OIDC customer identity federation, multi-factor PKI smartcard authentication, and fine-grained ABAC permissions.
